name: Modal
description: A full-overlay dialog component with scroll lock, focus management, and configurable size. Composed from Portal, Overlay, and FocusTrap. Includes ModalHeader, ModalBody, and ModalFooter sub-components.

notes: role='dialog' and aria-modal='true' are set on the dialog element.
aria-labelledby connects the dialog to ModalHeader's heading element.
Body scroll is locked (overflow:hidden) while the modal is open.
Focus is trapped inside via FocusTrap and restored to the trigger on close.
Clicking the Overlay closes the modal when closeOnOverlayClick=true (default).

onClose.description: Called when the modal should close.

size.description: Controls the max-width of the modal panel.

closeOnOverlayClick.description: When true, clicking the backdrop closes the modal.

closeOnEscape.description: When true, pressing Escape closes the modal.

children.description: Modal content. Typically composed of ModalHeader, ModalBody, and ModalFooter.

ModalHeader.description: Renders the modal title in a header element. Includes a close button. Provides aria-labelledby id to the parent dialog.

labels.description: Override default labels for internationalisation. ModalLabels: { close: string }.

ModalBody.description: Scrollable body area of the modal.

ModalFooter.description: Footer area, typically containing action buttons.

do: Always include a ModalHeader with a descriptive title for aria-labelledby.
Use ModalBody for scrollable content and ModalFooter for action buttons.
Provide a visible close button inside ModalHeader.
dont: Do not open a modal from inside another modal.
Do not use modals for simple confirmations — use a compact dialog with clear action labels.
Do not disable closeOnEscape without providing another keyboard-accessible close mechanism.
